description: Update an existing subscriber's profile, phone, status, attributes, or tags. Names and phones are native profile fields - set them here rather than as custom attributes. Setting status to unsubscribed suppresses the contact from all marketing, deactivates list memberships, and cancels active sequence enrollments while preserving the record and suppression history. Without automations:trigger, added tags start no sequence (sequenceTriggersRan false).

attributes.description: Custom attributes to merge into the existing map. This is the legacy MCP spelling; provide attributes or customAttributes, not both. Use firstName/lastName for names instead of attributes. Values keep their JSON types; call list_subscriber_attributes to match existing names and types.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

customAttributes.description: REST spelling for custom attributes. Replaces the existing public custom-attribute map, matching REST PATCH semantics; provide attributes instead when you want to retain unspecified keys. Provide attributes or customAttributes, not both.

email.description: Subscriber email address. Provide email or externalId to identify the subscriber.

externalId.description: Customer-owned subscriber ID. Provide email or externalId to identify the subscriber.

firstName.description: New first name, stored as a native profile field. Pass an empty string to clear it.

lastName.description: New last name, stored as a native profile field. Pass an empty string to clear it.

phone.description: New phone number in E.164 or national format, stored as a native profile field. Pass an empty string to clear it, which is rejected for a phone-only (SMS) contact that has no email. Changing the number resets SMS consent unless smsConsent is sent in the same call.

phoneCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used to read a national-format phone number, such as IT or US. Defaults to US. Only send it together with phone; the stored country always comes from the parsed number.

smsConsent.description: Set true only when express written SMS marketing consent was verified for this phone number; false unsubscribes them from SMS. Omitting this leaves consent unchanged unless phone changes, which resets consent because it belonged to the old number. Consent is never inferred from phone presence.

status.description: New global subscriber status. Use unsubscribed for compliance-grade suppression without deleting the record. Use bounced for an undeliverable address. Use complained when the contact reported spam: it records a company spam-complaint suppression, unsubscribes them and cancels their sequence enrollments, and the contact then reads as unsubscribed (the suppression shows in get_recipient_suppression). Use active only when the contact has valid consent to be resubscribed.

timezone.description: New IANA timezone identifier (e.g. America/New_York), stored as a native profile field. Pass an empty string to clear it. Enables recipient-local campaign delivery for this contact.

name: update_subscriber

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_subscriber` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequenceTriggersRan.description: False when no sequence could start from this call (see sequenceTriggersSkippedReason).

sequenceTriggersSkippedReason.description: missing_scope: key lacks automations:trigger (write still applied). not_requested: enrollInSequences false. historical: recorded as history.

subscriber.description: The subscriber record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
